validation.method: Per-source formerly uncovered face, bidirectional 5mm rays; seven origins coincident with parallel 5mm cap/identifier surfaces retried at 2mm; 40 floor/wall sphere sweeps. Backface queries were disabled. Initial 30cm ray method intercepted adjacent faces in merged chunks; no collision cooking fault found.

cause: New display-only prefab increments never acquired structural collision. Prior OuterWalkSurfaces patch covered selected floor support only.
geometry: Only active meshes in R08/R09-R18, L14/GI01, R24/R29/R35/R36R38; excludes name-classified decoration and parts smaller than 0.4m. Each retained nondegenerate world-space triangle is copied exactly and reversed for two-sided static contact. Existing coverage sampled at centroid and three interior points; already covered faces omitted. Grouped into source family and 16m centroid cells; no bounding hulls spanning doorways.
preserved: Original visual assets, collision components, interactive doors, lights, terrain, source prefabs and scripts unchanged. New root has only Transform and static nontrigger Layer0 nonconvex MeshColliders. No runtime rebuilding.

serialization.commitScene: Only new prefab instance plus SceneRoots reference; all existing HEAD records preserved. Concurrent worktree changes excluded.

limits: No actual player traversal, Play, network, build or performance acceptance.
Coverage is limited to listed static increments. Legacy MC00 render meshes often use separate authored collision proxies; not every MeshRenderer needs its own Collider.
Four-point triangle coverage sampling is not an exhaustive proof of every edge or doorway clearance.
Static snapshot must be regenerated if source geometry or placement changes.
